import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,base64,sys
z=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','14','-l','14','-scale-to','1200','-singlefile','-png','inputs/sources/sierpinski.pdf'],capture_output=True,check=True)
s=base64.b64encode(z.stdout).decode()
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','pdf-page-14.png','--base64'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print('PNG:'+s)
